caption: The drawing depicts a single, clear glass bottle positioned centrally against a plain, beige background. The bottle has a bulbous, rounded base that tapers gradually into a narrow neck with a slightly flared rim at the top. Light greenish-blue hues are used to illustrate the transparency and reflective character of the glass. The bottom interior of the bottle is shaded with deeper green tones to suggest its thickness and the way it distorts light, while lighter brush strokes along the sides and neck indicate the highlights and reflections on the glass surface. There are no additional objects or decorations in the composition, and the drawing is done in a realistic style with attention to the play of light and shadow on the clear material. The artist's signature with the date appears near the base on the lower right side of the image.
title: Blown Bottle
